meta.name: track-management
meta.description: Use this skill when creating, managing, or working with Conductor tracks - the logical work units for features, bugs, and refactors. Applies to spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理功能、缺陷和重构的开发工作单元与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发时需要把功能、缺陷和重构整理成有文档的工作单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize features, bugs, and refactors into trackable work units
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break dev work into tracked units with specs and plans

howto.what: Claude 会按 Conductor 的 track 机制帮你创建和管理特性、bug、重构这三类工作单元,写 spec.md 和 plan.md,并跟踪从创建到完成的阶段、状态标记和 tracks.md 登记。
howto.when: 当你要新建某个特性、bug 或重构 track,或要写、改 spec.md、plan.md,以及更新 track 生命周期状态标记时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能创建一个 track
say.note: 生成 track 及其 spec.md

say.text: 根据 spec.md 写一份 plan.md
把已完成任务的提交 SHA 记进 track

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create and manage Conductor tracks — the work units for features, bugs, and refactors — writing spec.md and plan.md and tracking phases, status markers, and the tracks.md registry.
howto.when_en: Use it when you create a feature, bug, or refactor track, write or review spec.md and plan.md, or update track lifecycle status markers.

say_en.text: Create a track for this new feature
say_en.note: Creates the track and its spec.md

say_en.text: Write a plan.md from this spec.md
Record the commit SHA for this finished task
